item.title: How to Use ChatGPT for Restaurant Marketing (in 30 Minutes a Week)
item.description: Use ChatGPT for restaurant marketing by giving it a one-time fact sheet about your restaurant, then batching a week of social posts, turning each special into a post, sign and text, drafting calm review replies and writing catering or event pages – about 30 minutes a week. Always check facts, prices and allergens yourself.

item.title: How to Make Your First $100 Online (With No Startup Money)
item.description: To make your first $100 online with no money, pick one path for 30 days (a simple service, a small digital product or affiliate posts), make one sample in two hours, set an easy-yes price of $25–$50 for a service or $3–$10 for a product, and send 20–50 offers where your buyers already are.
